content:
The Laredo Police Department held its own in-house HYROX simulation on Friday, putting officers through a fitness challenge built around strength, endurance, and teamwork.

The department shared photos and video of the event, describing it as a friendly competition and part of staying fit for duty and ready for the challenges ahead.

Sources: Laredo Police Department.
